name: Linus Torvalds Skill
tagline: Code-review skill distilled from 38k LKML emails
description: Linus Torvalds Skill distills Linus Torvalds' code-review methodology from his Linux kernel mailing list emails into a reusable, language-agnostic skill for AI agents. It is built from 38,293 real review moves extracted from 19,802 of his emails spanning 2003 to 2026. The repo ships skill files (the rules: triggers, precedence, definitions) in per-model variants generated with gpt-oss-120b, glm5.2, and mistral-small-4-119b, plus separate 'soul' files that replicate his persona and tone. The extraction pipeline is fully documented and reproducible, and the skill was validated with three independent model reviews of antirez/smallchat that converged on the same core defects. Everything is released to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
highlights: 38,293 review moves distilled from 19,802 of Torvalds' LKML emails (2003–2026)
Language-agnostic SKILL.md variants for gpt-oss-120b, glm5.2, and mistral-small-4-119b
Separate soul/persona files that replicate Torvalds' actual review voice
Reproducible pipeline (classify, extract, cluster, distill) with a 6,379-ID skip list to save API calls
Validated with three model reviews of antirez/smallchat converging on identical core defects
curatorNote: Most agent skills are generic prompt templates; this one is distilled from 19,802 real Linux kernel review emails through a documented, reproducible pipeline with multi-model validation. As CC0 public domain, it is a free, auditable baseline for code-review agent behavior.
